Same probe on before bytes: the semantic false Run PROPAGATES (root failure) and the undeclared same-named 'AdmissionError' class inside the stack is misrouted to REJECT (name matching). findings.typeIdentity: IM is the security loader's own identity copy (security_identity_model_v3); close_run normalizes its separate replay stack (composition_identity3) declared outcomes into IM classes, so except IM.C.AdmissionError is the exact-identity boundary for every declared owner refusal including CompleteReplayMismatch and EvidenceUnavailable.

findings.title: SEAL boundary does not impose the retained-regeneration public route at a live host
findings.evidence: admit_analysis_seal raises only the security-local Reject key SEAL_CLOSE_RUN_REFUSED:<first diagnostic line>; Reject carries no termination (hasPublicTermination false in every probe row) and SEAL_CLOSE_RUN_REFUSED has no D9/public-detail mapping in the security model. The chained cause is the origin-free identity condition CompleteReplayMismatch, not the RegenerationMismatch retained carrier, so the outer host keeps the origin decision (live first-party contradiction -> complete-replay-mismatch:host-internal). identity EvidenceStore.prepare and run_termination_model.retained_population likewise propagate the condition uncarried; only the retained restore boundary maps it to RegenerationMismatch.
findings.advisory: SI-A1: an outer host projection must select by the Reject __cause__ type (as the maintained typed controls assert), never by parsing the diagnostic text the Reject key embeds. No outer live-host fault projection exists in the reviewed files.
